&TV
, also known as
And TV
, is a
Hindi
-language entertainment channel owned by
Zee Entertainment Enterprises
(ZEEL). Launched as a general entertainment channel from ZEEL group, it started broadcasting on 2 March 2015 with internationally in Middle East.
[
2
]
[
3
]
On 6 April 2015, &TV launched in UK replace Lamhe. On 1 June 2019, &TV was closed in the UK due to the launch of
ZEE5
.
[
4
]
[
5
]
[
6
]
On 11 November 2024, &TV relaunched in the UK on
Samsung TV Plus
and
Rakuten tv
on 10 March 2025.
Associated channels
&Pictures
&Pictures
is a
Hindi
satellite movie channel in India based in
Mumbai
. The channel is owned by
Zee Entertainment Enterprises
.
[
7
]
It is the first channel of Zee Entertainment Enterprises under the new brand
&
.
[
8
]
&Xplor HD
&Xplor HD
is an HD-only premium movie channel owned by
Zee Entertainment Enterprises
. It was launched on 18 July 2019 only on
Airtel Digital TV
, but by late 2023, they added the channel on
Tata    Play
. It shows critically-acclaimed and arthouse Bollywood movies.
